## Professional Role

Research Devkota is the Co-Founder and lead fullstack developer at Navya EdTech
(navyaedtech.com), an enterprise IT services and software development company based
in Gwarko, Lalitpur, Nepal (founded 2026).

He is responsible for:
- Technical architecture and system design
- Building enterprise ERP systems
- Building LMS (Learning Management System) platforms
- Building CRM (Customer Relationship Management) software
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker)
- Full-cycle software delivery for business clients

He also teaches Python programming at Mero Coding Class.

Previously: Fullstack Developer at Miraai Solutions (Laravel production codebase).

Education: Bachelor of Information Management (BIM), Nepal Commerce Campus, Kathmandu (in progress).
